clips.title: The story
paras: At Coldridge Pass, Hands Springsprocket struggles to keep supplies moving between the valley and Kharanos. Rockjaw troggs have blocked the route.

Hands Springsprocket waits at the mouth of Coldridge Pass, where Rockjaw troggs have stopped his supply runs. He usually carries provisions to the Thunderbrew distillery and the inn in Kharanos. The troggs have overrun the underground tunnel out of Coldridge Valley, halting trade and foot traffic. Hands now depends on travelers able to carry essential crates through the dangerous mountain passage.
